definitions.explanation: An establishment where hairdressing, hair styling, coloring, and other beauty treatments are provided. Traditionally associated with women's hairdressing services.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}{美容院|びよういん}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I made an appointment at the beauty salon for tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {美容院|びよういん}で{髪|かみ}を{染|そ}めてもらった。
examples.english: I had my hair dyed at the beauty salon.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{新|あたら}しい{美容院|びよういん}がオープンした。
examples.english: A new beauty salon opened in front of the station.

notes:
{美容院|びよういん} is a beauty salon or hair salon.

SERVICES OFFERED:
- カット (haircut)
- パーマ (perm)
- {髪|かみ}を{染|そ}める / カラー (hair coloring)
- シャンプー (shampoo)
- トリートメント (hair treatment)
- セット (styling)

CONTRAST WITH BARBERSHOP:
- {美容院|びよういん} / {美容室|びようしつ}: beauty salon (traditionally for women, offers styling, coloring, perms)
- {理髪店|りはつてん} / {床屋|とこや}: barbershop (traditionally for men, offers simple cuts, shaving)

MODERN USAGE:
Today, many {美容院|びよういん} also serve male customers, and the distinction between beauty salons and barbershops has become less strict.

RELATED WORDS:
- {美容師|びようし}: hairdresser, beautician
- {美容室|びようしつ}: beauty salon (synonym)
